relations.statement: decodeRequest (encodeRequest fuel m input) = some (fuel, m, input)

lemmas.statement: Request code round trip: decoding an encoded request returns fuel, machine and input.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem decodeRequest_encodeRequest (fuel : Nat) (m : Machine) (w : List Nat) : decodeRequest (encodeRequest fuel m w) = some (fuel, m, w) := by sorry

lemmas.statement: The code-level evaluator on an encoded request equals the bounded evaluator on fuel, machine and the declared initial input.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem evalCode_encodeRequest (fuel : Nat) (m : Machine) (w : List Nat) : evalCode (encodeRequest fuel m w) = boundedEval fuel m w := by sorry

near_misses.claim: Concatenating fuel, machine tokens and input without a length token is uniquely decodable.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The machine segment and input word boundary is ambiguous without the length token; the machine-code length is required.
